text.name: Hainan Island Incident
text.rules: Record "collision". SAE spends 1 point on actions. LIO chooses: Say sorry? If yes, LIO spends 1 point on actions; if no, until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 1 more, then SAE spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: On 1 April 2001 a US Navy EP-3 reconnaissance aircraft collided with a Chinese fighter near Hainan Island; the Chinese pilot died and the 24 US crew were held for eleven days until a carefully worded US letter was accepted.
